dialogueLines.line: Like, are you a zombie? Do you eat brains?
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: I don't eat dogs. But I might eat your microphone.
dialogueLines.speaker: lily

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! I only want Scooby Snacks, not people.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: You talk too much. I like quiet prey.
dialogueLines.speaker: lily

dialogueLines.line: Like, why are you so quiet? Are you ok?
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: You smell like dog food, mutt.
dialogueLines.speaker: lily

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! You stare at me weird, Lily.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: Be quiet so I can focus on eating... I mean singing.
dialogueLines.speaker: lily
